mainEntity.name: What topics does Shilika Jain speak on?

acceptedAnswer.text: Six topics: the 2026 fractional PR motion replacing pre-Series B agency retainers; the three APAC press windows (WebX Tokyo, Korea Blockchain Week, Token2049 Singapore) that decide institutional flow; AI-Overviews citation share as a founder distribution lever; KOL waves as a regulatory product across seven jurisdictions; the cybersecurity vendor AI-citation gap and the four-pattern fix; pre-TGE comms inside the 8-week window most founders mis-spend. Each topic is delivered as a keynote, fireside chat, panel slot or podcast guest segment.

mainEntity.name: What speaker formats does Shilika Jain accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keynote 25 to 45 minutes, fireside chat 30 to 50 minutes, panel 45 to 60 minutes, workshop 60 to 120 minutes, podcast 30 to 90 minutes, closed-room press briefing 30 to 45 minutes. Pre-event topic memo provided for panels and fireside chats. Pre-call alignment on three to five anchor questions for podcasts.

mainEntity.name: Where is Shilika Jain based and how much lead time does a booking need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asia-Pacific base. Comfortable across UTC+5:30 to UTC+9 daily; US and EU with one week of notice. Confirmed podcast slots inside 7 days. Confirmed keynote slots inside 4 weeks. APAC travel inside 2 weeks possible. US, EU and LATAM travel 4 to 6 weeks ahead.

mainEntity.name: Does Shilika Jain charge a speaker fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paid keynote and workshop fees vary by venue, region and topic. Non-profit, educational and small-builder events frequently accepted pro bono. Honoraria and travel covered by host venue. Podcast appearances generally free for shows aligned with the topic ladder.

mainEntity.name: How do bookers contact Shilika Jain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Email shilika@shilikajain.com with the subject line 'Speaking enquiry' and include venue, date, format, topic preference, audience size, time zone and budget if known. Replies inside 3 business days. A Calendly 30-minute orientation call is available before booking confirmation.

acceptedAnswer.text: The speaker kit sidebar links a one-pager PDF, landscape and portrait press images and the long-form bio at /about. Verifiable byline list and recent press placements at /about and /work. Headshots are licensed for event-marketing use with credit to Shilika Jain.
